description: App windows. The app's own #[tauri::command]s (window_open/focus/close and the domain transport commands) are allowed by default and need no permission string; domain-channel Channels ride core IPC covered by core:default. Child windows (detached-*, project-*, workspace-*) load the same renderer and need the same core IPC, plus core:window self-close/start-dragging for their own chrome.
